access.edition_or_version: English translation by Richard Howard (Grove Press / Calder)

mechanics.point_of_view: External focalization by an unnamed, camera-like observer; no direct interior access.
mechanics.style_and_devices: Precise spatial catalogs; repetition and variation of surfaces; metonymic imagery; neutral registering of things.
mechanics.emotional_progression: Jealousy is never stated; it is inferred from the observer's obsessive attention and the geometry of the house.
mechanics.dialogue: Fragmented and reported at a remove; speech is one object among others.
mechanics.verification_note: Novel and its camera-eye narration confirmed; Robbe-Grillet's theoretical program in Pour un nouveau roman.
